note: Re-read 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after commit 60e9406387 removed the RFC6810-5.1-1 tags from these units; no assertion line changed. RFC 8210 Section 5.1 reads 'Max Length:  An 8-bit unsigned integer denoting the longest prefix allowed by the Prefix element.  This MUST NOT be less than the Prefix Length element.' Negative: TestParseIPv4PrefixMaxLenLessThanPrefixLen builds a version 1 (rtrVersionMin) IPv4 Prefix PDU with prefix length 24, a valid value, and max length 16, and asserts parseIPv4Prefix errors with 'invalid', so the buffer isolates the Max Length rule. Positive: TestParseIPv4Prefix accepts a version 1 PDU with max length 24 over prefix length 8 and pins the VRP's ASN, prefix and max length. The check sits in parsePrefixPDU, which the IPv6 parser shares; removing the maxLen < prefixLen test turns the negative red.
